services.name: Zipline Combo Tours
services.desc: Top of the Rockies Zip Line is open! Join us for an adventurous mountain tour! Check out the zip line Our Zipline Combo Tours combine the excitement of snowmobiling with the thrill of soaring through the treetops. Choose from any of our snowmobile tour options-Prospector, Performance, or High Adventure-and pair it with a zipline adventure for an action-packed mountain adventure. Tours can be scheduled back-to-back, like a 9 AM snowmobile tour followed by a 12 PM zipline, or with some flexibility in timing. Check-in is 30 minutes before each tour.
